reusable.what: Bar/beat helpers from a musical grid, pure progress combinators (seq, all, lagged, delay windows) and named easings for frame-driven 2D motion

Frame-driven text: a 6-frame clip-path wipe and fade (never typewriter), a bilingual EN + zh notes block on fixed baselines, explicit zh phrase breaks, grey (non-LCD) antialiasing through a layer hint
A 2D translate-and-scale camera over a large world, non-scaling strokes, and labels projected into screen space so they keep their size at any zoom
SVG diagram parts for dark ink maps: rings, platform boxes, pills, edges drawn on at a constant pen speed, tokens riding a path, dashed and hatched variants
Tapered, variable-width sketch strokes with seeded pressure, drawn as filled polygons (no filters)
A seeded dither tile laid out with Remotion (waited for, unlike CSS background images) to break up banding on dark grounds
